A natural transformation \(\eta:W_P\Rightarrow W_Q\) is determined as follows. Evaluate it at \((p,\mathrm{id}_P)\in P\times P^P\):
\[
\eta_P(p,\mathrm{id}_P)=(\sigma(p),\beta_p),
\]
where \(\sigma(p)\in Q\) and \(\beta_p:Q\to P\). By naturality, for every \(f:P\to X\),
\[
\eta_X(p,f)=\bigl(\sigma(p),\,q\mapsto f(\beta_p(q))\bigr).
\]

The counit condition gives
\[
\beta_p(\sigma(p))=p.
\]
The comultiplication condition gives, for all \(p\in P\) and \(q,r\in Q\),
\[
\sigma(\beta_p(q))=q,\qquad \beta_{\beta_p(q)}(r)=\beta_p(r).
\]
Thus each set
\[
B_p=\{\beta_p(q):q\in Q\}
\]
is a block on which \(\sigma\) is bijective onto \(Q\), and the blocks \(B_p\) partition \(P\). Conversely, any partition of \(P\) into blocks each mapped bijectively to \(Q\) defines a comonad morphism.

So a comonad morphism \(W_P\Rightarrow W_Q\) is exactly a partition of \(P\) into \(|P|/|Q|\) transversal blocks over \(Q\).

Now fix
\[
\Theta:W_S\Rightarrow W_T.
\]
Since \(|S|=abn\) and \(|T|=n\), \(\Theta\) partitions \(S\) into \(ab\) blocks, each bijective to \(T\).

First count possible \(\Psi:W_U\Rightarrow W_T\). Since \(|U|=bn\), such a morphism is a partition of \(U\) into \(b\) blocks, each bijective to \(T\). Temporarily label the \(b\) blocks: there are \((bn)!\) bijections \(U\to \{1,\dots,b\}\times T\). Forgetting the block labels divides by \(b!\), so
\[
\#\Psi=\frac{(bn)!}{b!}.
\]

Fix such a \(\Psi\). Its \(b\) blocks must be matched, inside each \(\Phi\)-block, with \(b\) of the \(ab\) fixed \(\Theta\)-blocks. A \(\Phi\)-block is therefore a group of \(b\) \(\Theta\)-blocks, one assigned to each \(\Psi\)-block. Temporarily label the \(a\) resulting \(\Phi\)-blocks. Then the \(ab\) \(\Theta\)-blocks can be assigned to the \(a\cdot b\) slots in \((ab)!\) ways. Forgetting the labels of the \(a\) \(\Phi\)-blocks divides by \(a!\). Hence, for fixed \(\Psi\),
\[
\#\Phi=\frac{(ab)!}{a!}.
\]

Therefore the number of ordered factorizations is
\[
\boxed{\frac{(bn)!(ab)!}{a!\,b!}}.
\]
